headline: Discussed proposed $3.45 million five-year technology lease for Chromebooks and Apple devices; no vote taken, more cost data requested.
summary: The Joint Finance & Curriculum Subcommittee reviewed a proposed multi-year technology lease agreement that would cost Lowell Public Schools about $3.45 million over five years for the district's one-to-one Chromebook program. Members discussed device costs, funding sources, and alternatives like Lenovo and Dell Chromebooks, and asked staff to prepare a cost comparison spreadsheet and device inventory before the Finance Subcommittee meets again.

Chairperson Bahou called the meeting to order at 5:35 p.m. The following agenda items were

Chairperson Bahou opened the meeting by stating that the evening's discussion would focus on
the proposed multi-year-technology lease agreement, which would cost Lowell Public Schools
approximately $3.45 million over five years. The agreement presented to the joint
subcommittee would cover the district's one-to-one Chromebook program for students.
Chairperson Bahou then asked Dr. Pinto to address the committee and provide an update on the
agenda items. Dr. Pinto asked Ms. Wilkins to come to the podium and speak to the
subcommittee about the use of these laptops with the students and teachers.
